title: Ollama Bot Thread Storage Foundation
description: Create thread storage system for Ollama bot conversations. Each conversation is saved to a JSONL file, separate from user's Zikaron data. TDD: write failing tests first.

acceptanceCriteria.text: RED: Write failing test for append(threadId, msg) - should create file if not exists
GREEN: Implement append() minimal code to pass
RED: Write failing test for getRecent(threadId, n) - returns last N entries
GREEN: Implement getRecent() minimal code to pass
RED: Write failing test for listThreads() - returns all thread IDs
GREEN: Implement listThreads() minimal code to pass
RED: Write failing test for malformed JSONL recovery
GREEN: Implement recovery logic to pass
REFACTOR: Extract ThreadStore class, add error logging
Verify all tests pass, output pristine
Run CodeRabbit review - must pass (or create BUG if unfixable)
